assembly_notes: Three independent structural slots and no multiplicity: board_style has two source-backed tops, sleeve_option adds or omits the transverse hinged sleeve surface, and support_style has five mechanisms, giving 2 x 2 x 5 = 20 combinations with no compatibility gate. board_style publishes a support station line under the shell and a raised sleeve seat; support_style consumes the station line while sleeve_option consumes the sleeve seat. The board is the assembly root even for the wall bracket, whose bracket and prop arm hang off it. Fold ranges and leg lengths are derived from the sampled spread so the feet reach the support plane and a folded support stops just under the top. Candidate-aware seed ranges preserve the compact proportions of the slotted tabletop origin and the longer proportions of the tapered board. cover_style is a decorative geometry parameter, sourced from the plain cover, irregular grid and elliptical patch treatments; it does not add to core/raw diversity.

derived.expression: the bearing lugs sit at +-(half_width_at(station_x) - 0.028 + 0.013) and the hinge rod stops 0.003 inside them
derived.name: station_span_m
derived.rationale: the lugs must follow the tapering top, not a fixed width

derived.expression: leg length = support_height_m + mount_z; the telescoping post adds its travel on top
derived.name: support_length_m
derived.rationale: every support family is cut to the height it has to reach

derived.expression: the sleeve hinge rides 0.016 outboard of the board edge on a bridging mount plate and raised posts at +-0.075 in x
derived.name: sleeve_hinge_y_m
derived.rationale: the sleeve must clear the board rail it folds over

category_anchor: the support carries a brace or lock
category_anchor: the support really folds or adjusts away from the board
the board keeps a source-like usable planform
category_anchor: the sleeve option matches the selected top
category_anchor: the sleeve board swings on its own hinge

candidates.evidence: _capsule sweeps a rounded, tapering silhouette, _perforated_tray builds the vented underside and _cover_pattern the padded cover — the classic narrowing board.
candidates.name: tapered_capsule

parameters.name: board_width_m
parameters.rationale: source boards are 0.29-0.38 m wide at the heel

parameters.name: taper_ratio
parameters.rationale: source noses are 0.35-0.7 of the heel width

parameters.name: cover_style
parameters.rationale: The sources show a clean padded cover, irregular line grid and elliptical patch treatment; this is decorative geometry and does not add to core/raw diversity.

parameters.expression: nose_width_m = board_width_m * taper_ratio; the half width at x follows a 1.6 power law
parameters.name: nose_width_m
parameters.rationale: the tapering silhouette is a real profile, not a scale factor

parameters.expression: station_x_m = 0.30 * board_length_m/2; both supports hang from that line
parameters.name: station_x_m
parameters.rationale: the support stations are placed from the board, not from constants

candidates.evidence: _slot_solid plus _perforated_pan and _ellipse_patch build a straight-sided slotted pan; the top keeps a constant width instead of tapering.
candidates.name: rect_slotted

parameters.name: board_length_m
parameters.rationale: The compact slotted origin remains independently scalable while seed sampling uses its source-like 0.62-0.94 m band.

parameters.name: board_width_m
parameters.rationale: The straight pan keeps a constant-width run with rounded slot ends.

parameters.name: cover_style
parameters.rationale: The sources show a clean padded cover, irregular line grid and elliptical patch treatment; this is decorative geometry and does not add to core/raw diversity.

candidates.evidence: The origin top is a single ironing surface with no second board.
candidates.name: plain_top

candidates.evidence: A second hinged sleeve surface on its own revolute joint stands on the retained main top.
candidates.name: sleeve_board

candidates.evidence: Two leg_frame_i hinge under the board (L219-L233) and each carries its own lock_brace_i hinged on the leg (L284-L298): a true scissor pair.
candidates.name: scissor_legs

parameters.name: spread_ratio
parameters.rationale: source feet spread 0.35-0.7 of the leg length

parameters.expression: short tabletop legs use 0.34 of the height and the wall bracket 0.55; every other support reaches the floor
parameters.name: support_height_m
parameters.rationale: each support family stands the board at its own real height

parameters.expression: fold = clamp(pi/2 - tilt - 0.12, 0.30, 1.30); a support folds only until it lies just under the board
parameters.name: fold_rad
parameters.rationale: the fold range is derived so a folded support never enters the top

candidates.evidence: Long floor-reaching crossed legs whose braces hinge on the board (L374-L388) instead of on the leg, giving a different closed loop.
candidates.name: floor_x_legs

candidates.evidence: Short legs sized to stand the board on a tabletop, with board-mounted braces; the whole support is a fraction of the standing height.
candidates.name: short_tabletop_legs

candidates.evidence: Two support_post_i on PRISMATIC height joints (L290-L307) with T crossbars and lock_collar_i twist locks (L328-L345): no folding leg at all.
candidates.name: telescoping_posts

candidates.evidence: A wall_bracket back plate carries the board on a fold-down REVOLUTE hinge (L473-L490) and a support_arm props it from the same bracket (L493-L510); the board never reaches the floor.
candidates.name: wall_bracket
